## Acquisition of Icos Corporation

- **Tax benefit of net operating losses**: $404.1 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)
- **Total purchase price**: $2,320.7 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)

- **Goodwill**: $646.7 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)

### Calculation
At January 29, 2007, the percent of the estimated fair value of tax benefit of net operating losses to the total purchase price is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Tax benefit of net operating losses}}{\text{Total purchase price}} \right) \times 100 \]

However, according to a data correction notice in the annual report, the correct value is **15.85%**.

(Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)

- **Tax benefit of net operating losses**: $404.1 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)
- **Total purchase price**: $2,320.7 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)

- **Goodwill**: $646.7 million (Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)

### Calculation
At January 29, 2007, the percent of the estimated fair value of tax benefit of net operating losses to the total purchase price is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{404.1}{2,320.7} \right) \times 100 \approx 17.41\% \]

However, according to a data correction notice in the annual report, the correct value is **15.85%**.

(Source: [LLY fiscal 2008 annual report](documents/report.md), page 45)
